title: Storage Bundle Program Rate by Storage Rental Rent — Parking License
content:
Storage bundle program terms. The program rate on which a Parking License's storage bundle discount rate is built rises with the monthly rent of the household's active Storage Rental.

## Terms

When the storage rental's monthly rent is at least $100.00, the program rate is the product's storage bundle rate plus 0.05; when it is at least $75.00 but less than $100.00, the program rate is the product's storage bundle rate plus 0.02; in every other case the program rate is the product's storage bundle rate.

The monthly rent read is that of the Storage Rental in active status on the same lease. The additions are percentage points of the discount rate: 0.05 is 5 points and 0.02 is 2 points.

## Program rate by Storage Rental rent

| Monthly rent of the active Storage Rental | Program rate |
|---|---|
| $100.00 or more | the product's storage bundle rate plus 0.05 |
| at least $75.00, less than $100.00 | the product's storage bundle rate plus 0.02 |
| less than $75.00 | the product's storage bundle rate |

## Illustrations (hypothetical product with a storage bundle rate of 10%)

- Storage Rental rent $100.00: 0.10 plus 0.05, a program rate of 0.15 (15%).
- Rent $99.99: 0.10 plus 0.02, 0.12 (12%).
- Rent $75.00: 0.12 (12%).
- Rent $74.99: 0.10 (10%).
